Smooth seamless white Hardie garage bay and bays flanking pale stone entry, single-piece black panels between triple-window rows; black panel above double entry door and between three stacked windows. Soft daylight, realistic glass reflections, blue sky/wispy clouds; distant trees low at sides behind house. Wide 2.1:1 composition, full building fills width, modest sky.
